home.heroTitle: Stream your living-room PC to every screen you own
home.heroSubtitle: temstream is a Chinese-language guide to Moonlight and Sunshine — free, cross-platform, and low-latency game streaming over your home network or the public internet.
home.featuresSubtitle: An open-source reimplementation of NVIDIA's GameStream protocol. Cross-platform, low-latency, and maintained by an active community.
home.howSubtitle: One PC hosts, any device plays — start streaming in three steps.

howSteps.title: Host encodes
howSteps.desc: Sunshine runs on your gaming PC, capturing the screen and audio and encoding in real time using NVENC, QuickSync or AMF.

howSteps.title: Stream over the network
howSteps.desc: The NVIDIA GameStream protocol (reimplemented by Moonlight) carries the video over LAN or via ZeroTier, Tailscale, or a custom VPN.

howSteps.title: Client decodes & plays
howSteps.desc: Moonlight on Windows, Android, iOS, Mac, Linux or TV decodes the video and sends your controller and keyboard input back to the host.

download.title: Download
download.subtitle: All builds ship from the temstream_release v0.4 dual mirrors (gitee by default, GitHub as backup). Install Sunshine on your gaming PC first, then Moonlight on the device you want to play on.
download.clientSubtitle: Runs on the device you want to play on. Windows and Android are first-class targets.
download.serverSubtitle: Runs on your gaming PC. Windows is the only officially supported PC host today.
download.mirrorHintZh: Mirror slow? Switch to the gitee mirror.
download.mirrorHintEn: Main mirror slow? Switch to the GitHub mirror.

tutorial.title: Safe and simple: stream with Sunshine in 4 steps
tutorial.subtitle: Powered by the temstream management portal — sign up and go. No plaintext credentials are ever stored, only hashes.

steps.title: Install Sunshine
steps.desc: Download and install Sunshine on your gaming PC. After install, right-click the Sunshine icon in the system tray and choose Config to open the configuration page.

steps.title: Register in the management portal
steps.desc: Fill in the form on the config page and submit your registration. The temstream portal only stores hash strings — no usernames or passwords are ever kept in plaintext, making it absolutely safe.

steps.title: Restart Sunshine or the gaming PC
steps.desc: After registration, restart the Sunshine service (or simply reboot the gaming PC) so the new user takes effect.

steps.title: Sign in on Moonlight and start streaming
steps.desc: Launch Moonlight on the device you want to play on, sign in with the account you just registered, and start streaming to your gaming PC.

items.q: Do I need an NVIDIA GPU?
items.a: No. Sunshine supports NVIDIA (NVENC), Intel (QuickSync), AMD (AMF) hardware encoders, as well as a software fallback.

items.q: Can I stream outside my home network?
items.a: Yes. The usual approach is ZeroTier, Tailscale or NordVPN Meshnet — software-defined networks that avoid exposing Sunshine's ports.
